{{Short description|Census in Estonia in 2021}}
The '''2021 Population and Housing Census''' ('''PHC 2021''') ({{langx|et|Rahva ja eluruumide loendus}} (''REL 2021'')) was a [[census]] that was carried out during 28 December 2021 – 22 January 2022 in [[Estonia]] by [[Statistics Estonia]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Population and Housing Census 2021|url=https://rahvaloendus.ee/en/census-2021/population-and-housing-census-2021|access-date=14 February 2026}}</ref>

The total population recorded was 1,331,824 persons, compared to 1,294,455 persons counted in the [[2011 Estonian census]].<ref>{{cite web|title=The results of the population census have been published|url=https://rahvaloendus.ee/en/news/results-population-census-have-been-published|access-date=14 February 2026}}</ref>

The 2021 Estonian census was based on data from official registers that were supplemented with information from a survey of a random sample of 60,000 people. The survey took place from 28 December 2021 to 22 January 2022.<ref>[https://rahvaloendus.ee/et/loendus-2021/metoodika Rahvaloenduse metoodika.]</ref><ref>[https://www.stat.ee/rahvaloenduse-hind-soltub-loendatavate-arvust-ja-metoodikast Diana Beltadze: Rahvaloenduse hind sõltub loendatavate arvust ja metoodikast.] Statistics Estonia blog, 16 December 2019. (used 20 December 2019). [https://web.archive.org/web/20191220152740/https://www.stat.ee/rahvaloenduse-hind-soltub-loendatavate-arvust-ja-metoodikast (archived)]</ref>.
